title: Cong slams Modi govt on VB-G RAM G grievance redressal rules

ai.summary: Congress criticized the government's VB-G RAM G grievance redressal rules for reducing workers' rights, claiming they remove accountability mechanisms and financial penalties from the law.

facts.claim: Congress alleged that the VB-G RAM G grievance redressal rules notified this week have further 'disempowered' workers
facts.quote: The Congress on Wednesday alleged that the VB-G RAM G grievance redressal rules notified this week have further “disempowered” workers, reducing their so called right to “yet another jumla”.

facts.claim: The rules removed penalties for failure to resolve grievances within seven working days
facts.quote: The draft Rules explicitly stated that failure to dispose of a grievance within seven working days would constitute a contravention of the Act and attract action under Section 27

facts.claim: The rules removed the obligation to initiate criminal proceedings in cases of financial irregularities
facts.quote: He also flagged the “removal” of the obligation to initiate criminal proceedings in cases of financial irregularities.

ai.background_note: The Congress criticized the government's VB-G RAM G grievance redressal rules for removing accountability mechanisms and financial penalties from the law, which they claim disempower workers.
